title: PracFastchunk
description: High-performance async chunk pre-generator with low CPU/RAM usage and adaptive TPS throttling.
body:
# FastChunk

A high-performance chunk pre-generator that uses less CPU/RAM than alternative options on the market.

## Features
- **Fully async loading** — uses `getChunkAtAsync`, never blocks the main thread
- **Adaptive TPS throttling** — monitors server TPS in real time and automatically scales speed up or down
- **Bounded concurrency** — caps the number of chunks loading simultaneously to prevent RAM spikes
- **Spiral ordering** — reduces disk I/O by walking chunks in region-file order
- **Auto-unload** — frees RAM immediately after generation if no players are nearby

## Commands
| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/fastchunk start <world> <radius>` | Start pre-generation |
| `/fastchunk pause [world]` | Pause temporarily |
| `/fastchunk resume [world]` | Resume |
| `/fastchunk stop <world>` | Stop and clear the task |
| `/fastchunk status` | View progress |

## Permissions
- `fastchunk.use` (default: op)

## Supported Versions
1.19 – 1.20.x (see the Versions tab for each release)
